# Ratecard

> Published AI API list prices (USD per 1M tokens), one row per model and provider, each with a source URL and check date. 85 rows, 78 verified, 14 providers. Last checked 2026-10-26.

## Data
- [All models (JSON)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/models.json)
- [Providers (JSON)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/providers.json)
- [Change log (JSON)](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/api/changes.json)
- [OpenAPI](https://ratecardai.pages.dev/openapi.json)
